features.summary: Firefox improved how small windows and cropped frames are zoomed, and refined focus navigation for popovers, text selection, and text-fragment links. It also made speculation-rules prefetching account for page referrer policies and wait until frames are ready, while tightening document editing and sanitization behavior; _several other changes were internal performance and reliability improvements_.

It also avoids unnecessary work while parsing inputs and prevents listbox selections from unexpectedly jumping back to the top.

They also ensure `sizeToContent()` has no effect inside embedded content browsing contexts.

features.summary: Firefox’s touch and pointer-event tests now check event sequences at the point a touch ends, rather than relying on an extra event that may not arrive. The updates also simplify platform-specific test settings and clarify a zoom-test helper’s name; they change test coverage, not browser behavior.

features.summary: The HTML parser’s executor is now kept alive for as long as the streaming parser needs it, helping prevent problems while a page is being read and processed. The parser’s source headers are also registered with the project, so they’re properly recognized by the build and development tools.

features.summary: A crash test was added to cover timing information for browser-generated content, ensuring it does not reuse an inappropriate cached timing reference. This strengthens regression coverage rather than changing a user-visible feature.

features.label: DOM events

patches.author: Simon Farre
patches.subject: Keep the source of event handlers forwarded to a window until they're compiled.

features.summary: Firefox now keeps the source of an event handler available until the handler has been compiled when it is forwarded to a window. This prevents the handler’s source from disappearing too early and improves reliability for web content using event handlers.

features.label: Docshell & navigation tests

patches.author: Andreas Farre
patches.subject: Only send previous entry on same-origin traversals.

features.summary: During same-origin back or forward navigation, Firefox now sends the previous history entry along with the traversal. The change is covered by navigation tests and is intended to keep history handling consistent.

features.label: Session history

patches.author: Vincent Hilla
patches.subject: Don't restore javascript: URIs from session restore.

features.summary: Firefox no longer restores `javascript:` URIs when bringing back a previous session. This avoids automatically re-running script-based addresses during session restore.

patches.subject: Dispatch `DOMContentLoaded` for XSLT result documents

features.summary: These test updates ensure XSLT-generated documents fire DOMContentLoaded, the browser event that signals a document has been parsed. They also remove outdated macOS test restrictions and adjust a content-process check so tests reflect current behavior.

features.label: Crashtests

patches.author: Bas Schouten
patches.subject: Ensure that native-anonymous content doesn't use a cached container timing root.

patches.author: David Shin
patches.subject: Make browsing context under printing browsing context not targetable.

patches.author: Bas Schouten
patches.subject: Ensure container timing records are always dropped when their root element might go away.

features.summary: These crash tests cover cases where page elements or their timing records disappear during browser operations, and ensure printing-related browsing contexts cannot be targeted as ordinary content. The goal is to catch crashes caused by cleanup and lifecycle timing, rather than introduce a visible feature.

features.label: Session history

patches.author: Vincent Hilla
patches.subject: Don't restore javascript: URIs from session restore.

patches.author: Nika Layzell
patches.subject: Back out SessionHistoryInfo ID checks,

patches.author: Vincent Hilla
patches.subject: Refactor GetLoadingSessionHistoryInfoFromParent and send aReloadFlags.

features.summary: Firefox now skips restoring `javascript:` addresses from saved sessions, so reopening a tab won’t unexpectedly run script code. Related behind-the-scenes updates keep session-history information and reload behavior in sync as pages are restored.

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Stop repeating moz.yaml in the license declarations

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Declare every about:license notice in moz.build

patches.author: Timothy Nikkel
patches.subject: Bug 2069703. Use the correct path for three upstream filenames in parser/expat/moz.yaml's include list. DONTBUILD

features.summary: These changes tidy the license records for Expat, the XML parser Firefox uses: they remove a duplicate reference, ensure license notices are declared, and correct paths to upstream files. They affect how licensing information is tracked, not how Firefox parses XML.

features.label: Htmlaccel

patches.author: Rong Bao
patches.subject: Implement htmlaccel on LoongArch64 platforms with LSX intrinsics.

patches.author: Jan-Niklas Jaeschke
patches.subject: Store SIMD strides directly into strBuf in the HTML tokenizer.

features.summary: Firefox’s HTML tokenizer, which reads and processes web page markup, now uses SIMD acceleration on LoongArch64 processors through LSX, a set of vector instructions for that platform. It also writes SIMD-processed data directly into its buffer, reducing extra copying; together, these changes can make page parsing more efficient on supported systems.

features.summary: Firefox reorganized browser-chrome test directories so their names follow the project’s eslint-test-paths conventions, including general browser tests, about pages, WebRTC, popups, and tab prompts. This is an internal test-layout cleanup with no intended user-visible behavior change.

features.label: DOM IPC (process model) gtests

patches.author: Dave Townsend
patches.subject: Expand SitePolicies to support containerized site data.

features.summary: The gtest coverage for SitePolicies now includes containerized site data, so tests can verify policy behavior when storage and site information are separated into containers. This strengthens Firefox’s privacy-related site isolation checks without changing normal page behavior by itself.

features.label: DOM IPC (process model) tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on TSan that pass there on try.

features.summary: A DOM IPC test that had been disabled under ThreadSanitizer (TSan), a tool that detects threading problems, was re-enabled after it passed in testing. This restores test coverage for Firefox's multi-process browser communication.

features.label: Speculationrules

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Avoid using ThinVec with a zero-size type in speculationrules.

features.summary: This is a small implementation cleanup in the Speculation Rules code: it avoids storing a zero-size type in ThinVec, which is not an appropriate data structure for that case. There is no user-visible feature change, but it makes speculative loading code safer and more correct.
